fitReason: Close fit for sample-efficient robot skill learning with physical manipulation and robust execution, including underwater mobile manipulation.

physicalEvidence.summary: LURE (OCEANS 2025) learns from demonstrations and combines trajectory editing, LQR and symbolic planning. Experiments use a BlueROV with a Reach Alpha 5 manipulator for loop-on-hook placement in laboratory and pool settings. Both authors are affiliated with his PeARL lab.
